City services

Parking permits

Residents can buy a yearly parking permit for their street online or at city hall during opening hours.

Hours:

Monday to Friday, eight in the morning to five in the afternoon, closed on public holidays.

  • Trash and recycling

    Carts are picked up once a week; put them at the curb by seven in the morning.

Water service.

Start, stop or move your water service with two business days of notice, and pay your bill online.
